primitives.name: Per-coach-team-season τ̂ Estimation
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## BS-1 — `coach_risk.py`: per-coach-team-season τ̂ estimation (PRIORITY 1) **Provenance:** VC-1 (1575, arXiv:2309.00756); CH-1/CH-2/CH-3/CH-4/CH-6 constraints.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: τ̂: estimated coaching risk (dimensionless), (c,t,s): coach-team-season identifier, r: region (own/opp half), WP: win probability bin.
primitives.assumptions: Data sparsity assumption: minimum 25 decisions per cell (CH-1). Hierarchical pooling structure (CH-6). Bias due to region-gap asymmetry (CH-4).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Sparse data regime (n < 25) triggers league-level pooling.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI τ̂-calibrated coach-team-season features for decision-audit scoring.
layer2.telemetry: Hamming accuracy on 4th-down opponent-half decisions (gate: ≥3 pp improvement over WP-max).

primitives.name: Shrunk Situational Win Probability Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## BS-2 — `situational_wp.py`: shrunk situational WP engine (PRIORITY 1) **Provenance:** VC-3 (0207 ADAPT); CH-5/CH-7 constraints; VC-2 (0247 baselines).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: p̂: maximum likelihood estimate (dimensionless), p̄: coarse-prior average (dimensionless), ñ: effective sample size (unitless), σ: game state vector.
primitives.assumptions: James-Stein shrinkage prior (CH-7). Baseline models for GO, FGA, PUNT, XP, 2PT actions. Sparse-cell regularization (n₀ = 50).
primitives.breakdown_regime: Coarse-state limit where n → 0 recovers the baseline prior p̄.

layer2.mapping: Serves as the core state-value oracle for GSE's situational reasoning.
layer2.telemetry: Brier score reduction on held-out 2026 drives (gate: ≥5%). Agreement with 4DB logic on audit set.

primitives.name: Coach-Decision Audit in WP Points
primitives.verbatim_quote: v2 adds {XP, 2PT} using 0247's 51%/98.4% baselines as priors.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: ΔWP: total wp left on table (points/drive), D: set of 4th-down decisions, optimal WP: expectation under BS-2.
primitives.assumptions: Audit assumes access to BS-1 τ̂ predictions and BS-2 optimal actions. No additional modeling assumptions beyond those primitives.
primitives.breakdown_regime: No-data limit where audit metrics become deterministic functions of τ̂ and optimal-action agreement.

layer2.mapping: Produces empirical coach-performance metrics for GSI's decision-audit pipeline.
layer2.telemetry: Mean wp gap, τ̂ agreement rate, and total wp loss per coach-season (audit consistency check).

reasoning_traces.think:
The three primitives form a compositional pipeline: CoachRisk (BS-1) estimates coaching deviation from win-probability maximization, SituationalWP (BS-2) provides the value oracle for optimal actions, and CoachAudit (BS-3) measures the resulting win-probability loss. The hierarchical pooling in BS-1 exploits the VC-1 framework's robustness to small-sample noise, while the James-Stein shrinkage in BS-2 stabilizes sparse state-action counts. Crucially, the τ̂ estimates serve as a conformal prediction interval for whether a coach's deviation is statistically significant relative to league noise. Failure modes include data contamination (e.g., injury effects not controlled for) and mis-specification of the pooling hierarchy, which could lead to biased τ̂ and inflated audit wp-loss estimates.
